**Ally: Time to Collect** is an ally quest given by the raider punk in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update.

Travel to the location given by the raider punk and locate the device, either a weapon case or armor case. Take the device back to the raider punk to complete the quest.
